purpose: Fail-closed post-run aggregate LSF audit. RELEASED_VERIFIED is valid only when validators independently parse the registered job's raw bjobs/bhist/bacct captures, scan stdout/stderr content, and recompute all four release-artifact digests.
raw_capture_storage_rule: Raw bjobs, bhist, bacct, stdout and stderr captures remain only in the A-side evidence directory. Git stores only aggregate receipt SHA-256 values.
real_lsf_fixture_capture: A-side no-BLIND /bin/sleep 2 probe captured LSF 9.1.3.0 held -> exactly one bresume -> DONE evidence. bhist uses Signal <CONT> requested, Waiting for scheduling after resumed, Starting (Pid), and Done successfully; bacct uses Status <DONE> plus Completed <done>.
history_capture_metadata_rule: Each bhist and bacct capture begins with exactly three ASCII metadata lines: # registered_at_utc=<UTC>, # resumed_at_utc=<UTC>, # captured_at_utc=<UTC>; remaining bytes are unmodified command output. Wrapper UTC values agree across captures, establish only control-operation order and the capture-resume HIST_HOURS window, and must not be numerically equated to LSF event-text timestamps because host clock/timezone skew is allowed.

validation.pending_template_rule: A template, pending status, late/missing metadata, field drift, or raw parser failure fails closed.
derived_requirements: target Job <ID> section has exactly one Signal <CONT> requested and one Waiting for scheduling after resumed
target Job <ID> section has exactly one Starting (Pid) and one Done successfully or Exited terminal
target section has no rerun/requeue/retry keyword
foreign Job sections are not globally counted
wrapper capture within HIST_HOURS without event-text clock equality
validation.same_job_rule: The expected job id and validated registration receipt bind every raw capture. Counts and PASS states are derived, never accepted as receipt fields.
